The activity requests synthesis of safety incidents, engagement issues, and product economics into an operational health briefing for leadership—a strategic analytics and reporting capability. None of the candidates fulfills this requirement:

- The agents (Access Provisioning, Asset Provisioning, Change Automation, Change Release Coordinator, Product Lifecycle Orchestrator, BOM Compliance Validator) are all tactical orchestrators focused on operational execution, not synthesis or reporting.
- The dataProducts (Product Change and Inventory Analytics, Product Impact Sales Intelligence) aggregate product/inventory metrics for campaign optimization, not operational health metrics spanning safety, engagement, and economics.

While topically adjacent through engineering changes and product management, none of these resources actually provides the comprehensive operational health briefing capability the activity describes.
